tool_args.rationale: The step-normalized shift (y − x_now)/(u_now − u_past) decreases smoothly toward a nonzero offset across the measured horizons. Fit that offset, exponential amplitude, and decay rate numerically; fresh confirmation tests whether this compact stationary law generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A zero asymptotic step contribution does not explain the observed decay as well as an exponential with a nonzero offset.
The large opposing step shifts indicate an additional transient response beyond simple relaxation from the present state.
The eight available observations span both step directions and several horizons, sufficient to fit the three-parameter candidate before fresh confirmation.
